newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed in quiet, end-week trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed in quiet, end-week trade.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday in markets becalmed by European holidays
Gasoline was steady as an open arbitrage to the United States ahead of the driving season was balanced by an enticing crack spread that may prompt refiners to crank up gasoline production.
Naphtha edged lower after two weaker cargo deals on Thursday.
Gas oil lost up to $3 a tonne on a combination of weaker futures and premiums. A closed eastern arb has improved supplies and pulled levels lower.
High sulphur fuel barges jumped $1 to $2 on buying and higher swaps. One player bought around 15,000 tonnes at $83 and $83.50 fob ARA. Cargo markets were quiet.
